title: The Productivity Mirage
summary: An article questioning whether modern productivity tools, techniques, and workflows actually deliver meaningful results or merely create an illusion of progress, resonating with many who feel trapped in endless cycles of optimization without tangible outcomes.
problem_solved: Explores why people feel productive yet accomplish less, challenging the cult of productivity optimization
why_valuable: Questions common productivity assumptions and helps readers distinguish real efficiency gains from mere busywork disguised as progress
